vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

🌿 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~8 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (16 logs now.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)

🛡️ the person in their 50s, with a nervous tic, Autumn, Kartono and the man in his 60s met them at the door — 4 put down. the person in their 50s, with a nervous tic, Autumn, Kartono, the man in his 60s are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Marcus — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Marcus chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Kartono, Sartika, Theo and Marcus met them at the door — 4 put down. Kartono, Theo, Marcus are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Wei, Kartono, Sartika, Elena and Omar met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Wei, Kartono, Sartika, Elena, Omar are hurt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Marcus Webb, 41 — an electrician. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Lucky Rock, Cold-Blooded, Berserker Rage, Night Eyes.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kartono, Sartika, Elena, Omar and Chloe met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Sartika, Elena, Omar, Chloe are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
